julia: heads-up 1: launch blog + webinar landing went live last night. dashboard spike but lead capture below plan. https://redwood.app/dash/launch-landing :eyes:

ron: quick scan 1: impressions +45%, clicks +12%, but MQLs -18% vs forecast. landing CTR ok, drop is in post-click reg flow.

tara: pulling the funnel: registration start->submit shows 68% drop. form abandonment highest on phone field and quiet on social proof. also noticed UTMs differ: some links use `utm_campaign=launch_march` and others `utm_campaign=launch_march_v2`.

ben: also seeing a large unattributed direct bucket that lines up with our shortlink rdw.io. test: rdw.io/launch redirects without querystring. that's killing attribution for some paid/social posts.

linkbot: shortlink-checker: rdw.io/launch -> strips querystring (rule=strip_qs_on_legacy). rdw.me/launch -> preserves querystring (ok).

julia: okay action list: (1) temporary: present combined vs attributed in this week's KPI pack, show the split and note link hygiene risk; (2) ops to switch active creatives to rdw.me canonical; (3) analytics to run 60d benchmark-aligned numbers for the narrative slide; (4) quick messaging microtest on webinar CTA for 48h.

ron: will prepare combined vs attributed series for the deck. recommend showing both 7d and 30d attribution windows in appendix to illustrate sensitivity.

tara: will run the 60d backfill and export two CSVs (benchmark_aligned.csv, dashboard_native.csv). ETA 8h.

ben: I'll update the creative links to rdw.me and add a redirect rule to preserve querystrings. rolling change now, expect <2h.

metrics-bot: snapshot: combined MQLs=587, campaign-attributed=421, unattributed_direct=166 (snap id: snap-3632109876).

julia: perfect. @ron add a short note on margin of error for attribution to the narrative. @tara attach the backfill results to the deck channel when ready. @ben confirm when redirects complete. We'll present main KPIs using dashboard default (7d) and call out the attribution caveat.

ben: redirects done. tested rdw.me links preserve UTMs. starting backfill for rdw.io-sourced events.

julia: thanks team. we'll also run a 48h CTA variant test on webinar page: Variant A (short form) vs B (social proof). @tara please tag results in the KPI appendix. Meeting end. :white_check_mark:
